correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the smooth derivative with deletion of singleton boundary runs, factoriality, ten parity-return atoms of length at most eight, and greedy even-Parikh cut blocks. The first parity cut after distance 38 must lie in {38,40,42,44}; each block has a bounded-4 self-shuffle coloring. Swapping both colors between blocks forces a color change at block boundaries and preserves the two equal infinite output streams. Independently generated exactly 22,194 nonempty smooth words through length 44 and rechecked ALL 2,764 TSV positive certificates (length counts 538,674,682,870), with exact root equality and maximum monochromatic run four. Exhaustive independently implemented prefix-comparable residual-state search certified all twelve stored negative witnesses, including the length-38 bound-three obstruction and shorter four-length windows. These finite certificates prove the finite window; the infinite theorem additionally requires the parity-atom argument and infinitely many even-Parikh prefixes.
residual_risks: Four is a proved infinite upper bound, not optimality for every infinite smooth word.
The 38 lower bound applies only to the specified four-consecutive-length finite window, not every alternative constructive method.
Kolakoski inclusion depends on its known infinitely many parity-return prefixes.
